author: Telos I
title: Telos I - Parsimonious SOTA with 2000 HVGs
abstract: Fifth experiment for a future paper. This runs my new parsimonious SOTA pipeline (GraphFWPCA + DAQB, no PBVE-lite) with 2000 HVGs instead of 1500, to test if the FWPCA benefit is dependent on the truncated gene set.
